# Annie Wright, LMFT

> Trauma-informed therapy and executive coaching for high-achieving women, specializing in relational trauma recovery and nervous system healing.

Annie Wright is a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) and EMDR-certified clinician offering one-on-one therapy, executive coaching, and online services across 14 US states. She has been featured in Forbes, NPR, NBC, Business Insider, and 120+ media outlets, and provides signature programs like Fixing the Foundations for ambitious women seeking to heal relational trauma.
